title: Marketplace SaaS
shortDesc: Multi-tenant SaaS marketplace for centralized vendor + storefront.
description: Engineered a scalable multi-tenant e-commerce SaaS platform using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma ORM. The platform enables multiple vendors to operate independently under a centralized marketplace architecture, with vendor management, product cataloging, role-based access control, relational data management, and dynamic storefront rendering. Built the backend using a monorepo architecture and integrated RESTful APIs with Redux Toolkit Query for efficient frontend-backend communication.
highlights: Engineered a scalable multi-tenant e-commerce SaaS platform
Implemented centralized vendor management and product cataloging
Built dynamic storefront rendering for individual vendors
Implemented secure role-based access control across the platform
Designed relational data management using PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM
Built RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js
Integrated Redux Toolkit and RTK Query for frontend state and API management
Worked on vendor onboarding and core marketplace workflows
Integrated NATS, Redis, and BullMQ for messaging and background processing
Supported Razorpay, Shiprocket, and Socket.IO integrations
Contributed to ONDC integration and end-to-end platform testing

title: Emilo Gifting
shortDesc: Vendor and admin e-commerce platform for management & monitoring.
description: Developed a full-stack vendor management platform for Emilo Gifting using React and Express.js. The application enables vendors to manage products, inventory, orders, and transactions through an intuitive dashboard. It also includes an admin panel for overseeing vendors, products, categories, orders, and platform operations. The system focuses on secure authentication, efficient product management, responsive UI, and seamless business workflows.
highlights: Developed vendor dashboard for product and inventory management
Built admin panel for vendors, products, categories, and order management
Implemented secure authentication and role-based access control
Managed order lifecycle and transaction tracking
Created responsive dashboards using React and Express.js
Integrated REST APIs for seamless frontend-backend communication
Optimized application performance and user experience

title: Green Palna
shortDesc: A government web platform for managing plantation distribution, tracking saplings
description: Developed the frontend of the Green Palna web platform using React for the District Magistrate's environmental initiative. The system digitizes the distribution of five plant saplings to pregnant women by managing beneficiary registration, plantation records, verification, and administrative workflows. The backend was built with PHP and MySQL, enabling secure data management, form processing, and efficient record tracking through an admin dashboard. The platform streamlined paper-based operations into a centralized digital system for government officials.
